[b]Custom NPC Nari – English Translation (Fan Fix)[/b][b]Status: No longer maintained[/b]
[quote]⚠️ This fan translation and fix is no longer being updated. The original mod by [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18830]requeksm[/url]﻿[/i] has not received updates since February 3, 2024. Out of respect for the creator's work and IP, I will not be continuing updates, including loader compatibility or standalone versions.
For an actively maintained alternative, check out:
👉 [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33181]Bezajel’s “Nari English Translation and 1.6 Update”[/url]﻿[/b][/quote][line]✨ [b]Features[/b][list]
[*]English translation for all of Nari’s dialogue and text
[*]Cleaned and fixed schedule files and JSON formatting
[*]Bug fix for broken or missing character portraits
[*]Compatible with the original "Custom NPC Nari" mod by [i]requeksm[/i]
[/list]
